children.name: water-copy
children.text:
Water leaves foliage as vapour.
Evaporation uses energy,
helping cool the surrounding air.

children.name: shade-copy
children.text:
Leaves intercept
sunlight before it
heats the surface.

children.name: intro
children.text: A canopy changes what reaches the ground — and what leaves the tree.
